note: Expanded follow-up dialogue for the five named NPCs plus Sarah. Each follow-up is gated by source interactions the player has already completed (never proximity), keeps to at most three options, and never quizzes right after a read. The open response it leads to is a separate, spaced interaction (see leadsToPromptId and the item's minSpacingInteractions). Lines follow the fiction voice rules: short, human, oblique, no em dashes, and NPCs never reference the Archive, overlay, or any assessment. The concept is never named by the character.

followups.name: Abigail Mercer

gate.note: After the press job or the type-case read.

openingLines: Wet sheets dry slow, and the street won't wait for them.
Every copy off this press is one more voice out the door.

options.reply: One shout the wind takes. A hundred sheets, folk pass hand to hand.

options.text: Is that what gets printers in trouble?
options.reply: The Crown taxes our paper first. We noticed first too.
Mind the ink. Off with you.

followups.spacingNote: The open response linked here fires at least two committed interactions later, not in this exchange.

followups.name: Thomas Bell

gate.note: After the non-importation notice or the tavern-note errand.

openingLines: Half the shelves in this town could go bare and I'd sign it twice.
It's not the shilling. It's the not being asked.

options.text: Does not buying really do anything?
options.reply: London's merchants feel an empty ledger fast. They'll shout at Parliament for us.

options.text: What if folk won't hold the line?
options.reply: Then it's just my shop losing custom. It only bites if we all bite.
Go on then. Tell no one where you heard it.

followups.spacingNote: Linked open response is deferred; Thomas does not test the runner on the spot.

followups.name: Mr. Pike

gate.note: After delivering the proof and reading the schedule.

openingLines: A deed with the stamp, a deed without. Come fall, only one will stand.
Paper is the whole of my trade, and they've taxed the paper.

options.text: Which papers matter most to you?
options.reply: A writ binds. A deed proves. A newsprint sheet is just talk with ink.

options.text: And if they search a man's shop?
options.reply: On one open warrant, any door. That's the part folk can't stomach.
Mind the stamp date. First of November.

followups.spacingNote: Both linked open responses are spaced later; Pike keeps this to shop talk.

followups.name: Edward Clarke

gate.note: After hearing Clarke out and seeing resistance evidence.

openingLines: You young ones cheer the mob. You won't cheer where it ends.
A hanged straw man today. A hanged neighbor tomorrow, mark me.

options.text: So how do you see the effigy?
options.reply: Lawful men settle a grievance in the courts, not at the end of a rope on a tree.
Consent. And who consents to a broken window? Order first, then your fine words.
See that you do. Keep clear of that crowd.

followups.spacingNote: The linked open response explicitly separates voicing Clarke's view from agreeing with it, and fires later.

followups.name: The rider

gate.note: After meeting the rider or the crier stretch.

openingLines: Bell rings, I ride. Late bundles stay in Boston.
Word's only worth something if it gets there before the trouble does.

options.text: Which way would you carry it?
options.reply: Depends who's watching the road. Fast and seen, or slow and safe. Never both.

options.text: How does the next town even hear?
options.reply: Tavern to printer to me, and me to the next rider. Chain's only strong as the slow link.

followups.spacingNote: The route open response is a later, spaced interaction, not asked in this exchange.

followups.name: Goodwife Sarah

gate.note: After buying or hauling at Sarah's stall.

openingLines: Fish and thread, love. What's left of it.
Half my trade's gone since the new duties, and the notices say it's for the King's debt.

options.reply: Ships sit. Fees bite. What doesn't come in, I can't sell out.
Bless you. It's honest thread, at least.
And you, love. Mind the crowd up the way.

followups.spacingNote: Links to the compare item, which is offered later once the revenue proclamation is also engaged.
